en.t: This is a story from three years ago.

units.source_text: 某出家人老丑角出现在蹬球戏棚里。

en.t: An old clown dressed as a monk appeared in the ball-balancing show tent.

units.source_text: 每当这个丑角出家人逗得观众哄堂大笑的时候，就一次次地回首望着舞台的右侧。

en.t: Whenever this monkish clown made the audience roar with laughter, he kept turning back to look toward the right side of the stage.

units.source_text: 那里有什么让人在意的东西吗？

en.t: Was there something over there that troubled him?
I thought it strange and looked closely,

units.source_text: 看见一个十四五岁的姑娘把身子藏在手拉的帷幕里，目不转睛地望着出家人，感到十分担心。

en.t: and saw a girl of fourteen or fifteen hiding herself in the hand-drawn curtain, staring fixedly at the monk and looking terribly worried.

units.source_text: 姑娘挂着一副好胜的面孔，手指上缠着白色绷带，赤着脚，虽然只是初秋，可让人看着觉得很冷。

en.t: The girl had a defiant face, white bandages wrapped around her fingers, and bare feet; though it was only early autumn, she looked cold to see.

units.source_text: 她多么认真专注地望着出家人。

en.t: How earnestly and intently she watched the monk.
Only this girl did not laugh.

units.source_text: 出家人越逗观众发笑，就越发一味回头望着姑娘。

en.t: The more the monk made the audience laugh, the more persistently he turned back to look at the girl.

units.source_text: 姑娘的眼神显得那么认真，不知怎的，大概是受不了吧，她显得心情焦躁，像是想哭又像是要生气。

en.t: The girl's gaze was so earnest that, somehow, perhaps because she could not bear it, she looked restless, as if she wanted to cry and as if she were about to grow angry.

units.source_text: 为此，丑角的表演越发出神入化，观众笑得死去活来。

en.t: Because of this, the clown's performance grew still more masterful, and the audience laughed themselves helpless.

units.source_text: 可是，唯独站在舞台一角帷幕里的姑娘始终没有泛起一丝微微的笑容。

en.t: But the girl standing in the curtain at one corner of the stage never once let even the faintest smile appear.
